about.text: The Tuvan milk spirit, distilled from khoitpak, a soured milk drink, and also from kumis; made only in summer, when there was milk to spare.

how.text: Nothing is added. The khoitpak heats at the bottom of the pot; steam condenses on the cold-water container and trickles out of the long spout of the shuuruun. No temperatures or times are given.
